Maya Patel: Quick design review: added a Figma frame for the rollout minimap + rollback UX. https://www.figma.com/file/xyz Maya Patel: Main goals: make canary control discoverable on mobile; soften rollback language; ensure keyboard navigation for version groups. Jonas Li: Love the minimap layout. Accessibility flag: canary vs baseline colors on gray background are ~3.2:1 contrast, need 4.5:1. Recommend thicker stroke plus hatch pattern for colorblind users :eye: Jonas Li: Also think a subtle pulse for the active segment (not just color swap) preserves meaning for low-vision. Priya Nair: Rollback modal copy suggestion: current header "Rollback to version X" -> "Confirm rollback to v2.1". Lead line: "This reverts traffic routing and config tied to this release." Secondary: "This can be scheduled; immediate rollback may disrupt active sessions." Priya Nair: Canary label microcopy: change "Canary %" -> "Canary traffic (%)" and add tooltip: "Start at 1-5% for initial validation. Monitor for ~15 minutes before ramping." Alex Gomez: Interaction notes: segments need visible focus. Proposed keyboard: Tab to focus segment, Enter to edit traffic, Left/Right arrow to move. Add aria-roledescription="timeline". Alex Gomez: Example accessibility snippet: ```
Schedules traffic revert. Notifies owners and downstream services. ``` Maya Patel: Good snippets. Jonas, can you push a patterned-fill variant? Priya, can you draft both concise and expanded rollback messages for PM sign-off? Jonas Li: Will add hatch/stripe patterns and thicker outlines in the Figma file by EOD. Priya Nair: I'll post two variants and add the helper line for monitoring. Also proposing to call out "Schedule" as the primary action and keep "Rollback now" as a secondary red action to avoid accidental triggers. Aria Chen: Version-history grouping idea: collapse by day with a small chevron, add filters (canary, hotfix, rollback tag). For power users, optional H/J/K/L nav between days. Aria Chen: Add aria-live="polite" to the events feed to announce important rollout changes without unnecessary chatter. Alex Gomez: Small UI nit: the rollback confirm CTA is prominent red. We should surface scheduling as the safer default (Schedule vs Immediate). Two-step reduces mistakes. Maya Patel: Agreed. We'll default to "Schedule rollback" and expose an "Immediate" toggle in the modal. Also adding a 30s delay micro-interaction to let users cancel. deploy-bot: Canary started: v2.1 at 5% traffic - build #8542 - 2025-03-15T14:52:12Z Priya Nair: I'll assemble an accessibility checklist for the PR: contrast ratios, visible focus, ARIA labels, live region, keyboard shortcuts, pattern fallbacks. Maya Patel: Next steps: Jonas (Figma patterns), Priya (copy + checklist), Aria (timeline prototypes + filters), Alex (keyboard/focus QA). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar: Jonas Li: ack. Priya Nair: ack. Aria Chen: ack. Alex Gomez: ack. Maya Patel: I'll attach the design PR when ready.
